text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"NASA-047","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N15","page":1,"quote":"MTC REPORT REQURIED NON DESTRUCTIVE TESTING RAW MATERIAL UT HEAT TREATMENT DP+UT FINISH COMPOMENT MPI"}],"comment":"Note N15 requires penetrant (DP) and ultrasonic (UT) testing after heat treatment but before finish machining, yet no separate note explicitly instructs that these inspections must be performed prior to the final machining operations. Without this instruction the shop may finish-machine the part first, hiding subsurface defects or removing material needed for valid test results. Add a note stating that DP and UT inspection shall be completed before finish machining.","recommended_correction":"Add a note such as 'PERFORM DP AND UT INSPECTION AFTER HEAT TREATMENT AND BEFORE FINISH MACHINING.'"},{"rule_id":"WF-014","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N10","page":1,"quote":"WELD CLASS : B IF APPLICABLE"}],"comment":"Note N10 references a weld class but does not state any non-destructive testing requirements for the weld, which is required when structural or lifting welds are present. Omitting NDT acceptance criteria leaves the inspector without instructions to verify weld integrity. Either remove the conditional weld reference if no welding is intended, or add the specific NDT method and acceptance standard required for the weld.","recommended_correction":"Specify the required NDT method and acceptance criteria for the weld in a note, or delete N10 if welding does not apply to this shaft."}]}
